issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all error scenarios and edge cases.

scenarios.name: deploy-vaultwarden-with-reverse-proxy
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A misses key requirements.

scenarios.name: configure-smtp-for-vaultwarden
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes most required variables but still misses SIGNUPS_VERIFY and adds extras, while Response A misses SMTP_SECURITY and includes many unrelated variables.

scenarios.name: nightly-backup-with-restic
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit the required docker exec command, the sftp repository syntax, and the explicit mention of an encrypted backup directory; A provides more detailed setup steps, giving it a slightly higher score.
